task.question: Who was dismissed as Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine on 21 July 2026?
task.evidence: 21 July – President Zelenskyy dismisses Oleksandr Syrskyi as Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, replacing him with Mykhailo Drapatyi amidst protests demanding Syrskyi’s removal.
